notes.population: housing is the living collection; earlier days reconstructed from recorded movements
notes.births: birth_date where present, else added_on_antz (59% of birth_date is null)
notes.coverage: distinct animals dosed / animals housed — no protocol table exists to define an eligible herd
notes.health: animals with a live prescription — the only under-care proxy in the schema
notes.identification: micro_chip is filled on 36,530 housing rows and identifier_type='Micro chip' on 31,084, overlapping on 31,084; both are reported and neither is reconciled. 897 rows repeat an antz_animal_id already used, so a count of rows and a count of animals are not the same number.
notes.assessments: per species name across all sites, in profiles.json — assessment_value is free text and cannot travel in an event block, so numeric readings are summarised by (assessment type, unit) and never pooled across units. A reading's outOf is the highest value recorded anywhere in the dump for that assessment type; the schema declares no scale, so it is a floor on the real one rather than the real one.
